items.title: Sir Edmund Hillary The Race For Everest
Hillary Clinton & Louise Penny, "State of Terror" : CSPAN2 : August 31, 2022 4:43am-5:42am EDT
items.description: Former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton and co-author Louise Penny discussed their novel, "State of Terror," about a fictional Secretary of State who has to deal with a world where U.S. leadership has been absent. This virtual event was hosted by Scattered Books in Chappaqua, New York.
